name: Debt Owed
overview: Scripture teaches that debt is not only a financial matter but also a spiritual responsibility, calling believers to mercy and forgiveness. Deuteronomy 15:1 commands the release of debts every seven years, emphasizing God's provision and grace. Proverbs 19:17 highlights that lending to the poor is akin to lending to the Lord, who will repay such generosity. In the New Testament, Jesus instructs His followers to forgive debts as they seek forgiveness themselves (Matthew 6:12), warning against judgmental attitudes (Matthew 7:1) and encouraging continual forgiveness beyond limits (Matthew 18:21). Furthermore, Matthew 6:1 reminds believers to practice righteousness humbly, ensuring that acts of giving and forgiving honor God rather than seeking human approval.
